method: Full-core semiglobal Levenshtein, both orientations; <=floor(0.2*core length) edits
internal: At least 50 nt from both read ends
near_join: Adapter interval intersects join interval +/-75 nt
homopolymer: A or T run >=10 nt, same internal and near-join bounds
limitations: Not all RNA002 RMX/motor adapters are represented.
Partial-core fragments and raw-signal read concatenation are not resolved.
Basecalled RNA may not represent the DNA adapters faithfully.
No hit is not proof of an artifact-free molecule.
Homopolymers can be biological; flags do not alter frozen RNA ranking.
